notes.1.1.1: Auto-update on 2026-09-08. All patch anchors unchanged (OPEN_DEV_TOOLS, closeDevTools hook, CAM spawn env, preload, CSP).
notes.1.2.0: Verified 2026-09-16 against the 1.2.0 installer and the 1.1.0 baseline. Electron 39.8.10. Every patch anchor still matches (main marker, devtools x2, cam-docs, preload, CSP, scene, sim-runtime, model-import, multi-side 9/9, bed-size 4/4, stock-sim). window.api only gained auth.*; IPC channel set, hooked handler signatures, device.ipc chunk, CAM endpoints and renderer anchors are unchanged. New in 1.2.0: app IPC handlers reject invokes from frames outside out/renderer (mod UI runs in the app frame, so unaffected); CAM restart waits for port 9630 to free up (toolpath-modifiers uses protocol.handle, no port). The vendor also dropped resources/ArcWelder.exe and its Arc fitting checkbox; the arc-fit mod was removed from this repo on 2026-09-17 in response.
